comment.description: A description of what the analytics rule detects.

data-connector.description: Required data connector(s) or table(s) the query depends on.

entity-field.description: Query result field mapped to an entity, paired with entity-type.

entity-type.description: Entity type mapped from the query results (e.g. Account, Host, IP).

mitre-attack-tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic(s) associated with the rule.

mitre-attack-technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique(s) associated with the rule.

product.description: Microsoft product the KQL analytics rule is deployed on.

query.description: KQL (Kusto Query Language) query implementing the detection.

query-frequency.description: How often the query runs (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H).

query-period.description: Look-back period searched by the query (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H).

reference.description: Reference URL for the rule source or documentation.

rule-id.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the analytics rule.

rule-name.description: Human-readable name of the analytics rule.

trigger-operator.description: Operator used to compare the result count against trigger-threshold.

trigger-threshold.description: Result count threshold that triggers an alert.

description: An object describing a Microsoft Sentinel or Microsoft Defender XDR KQL analytics rule (Scheduled/NRT), including scheduling, alert thresholds, entity mappings, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
name: kql-analytics-rule
